question: Who was the flag bearer for the opening ceremony of the Asian Games 2018?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neeraj Chopra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Asian Games:

 
• Asian Games, a multi-sport event for all Asian countries, took place in the Indonesian cities of Jakarta and Palembang from august 18 to September 2, 2018.
 
• This was the 18th edition of the tournament, which first began in 1951 in New Delhi, and it was set for around 10,000 athletes in 40 sports from 45 countries.
 
• Indonesia hosted the Asian Games for the second time, after the Jakarta Asian Games in 1962.
 
• It was the first time (2018) that the games are being hosted by two cities together.
 
• Mascot: Bhin (a greater bird of paradise), Atung: a Bawean deer, and Kaka: a Javan rhinoceros, representing the eastern, central, and western regions of Indonesia.
 
• Asian Games 2018:
 
 
• India competed at the Asian Games in Jakarta and Palembang from august 18 to September 2, 2018.
 
• Neeraj Chopra was the flag bearer for the opening ceremony while Rani Rampal was named as the flag bearer for the closing ceremony.
 
• India ranked 8th in the 2018 Asian Games medal table with 69 medals in total including 15 gold, 24 silver, and 30 bronze.
 
• China topped the medal tally with 132 golds and a total of 289 medals.
 
• Japanese swimmer Ikee Rikako has been named as the most valuable player of the 18th edition of the Asian Games.
 
 
 
• The 19th Asian Games will be celebrated in Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China from September 23 to October 8 in 2023.
 
• Hangzhou will be the third Chinese city to host the Asian Games, after Beijing in 1990 and Guangzhou in 2010.
